changeSet.author: dts
changeSet.comment: Route PRS dbt-backed fixed reports to the dbt mart database instead of ptr_mysql.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO analytics_database ( name, engine, database_role, details_json, description, is_sample, timezone, metadata_sync_schedule, cache_field_values_schedule, auto_run_queries, is_full_sync, is_on_demand, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT 'DTS dbt模型库', 'postgres', 'BUSINESS_SECONDARY', '{"jdbc-url":"jdbc:postgresql://${DTS_DBT_DB_HOST:host.docker.internal}:${DTS_DBT_DB_PORT:5432}/${DTS_DBT_DB_NAME:biadmin}","user":"${DTS_DBT_DB_USER:biadmin}","password":"${DTS_DBT_DB_PASSWORD:}"}', 'DTS dbt build output database for PRS table-backed fixed reports.', false, 'Asia/Shanghai', null, null, true, true, false, ${now}, ${now} WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analytics_database WHERE lower(name) = lower('DTS dbt模型库') );
UPDATE analytics_report_template SET spec_json = jsonb_set( spec_json::jsonb, '{queryContract,databaseName}', to_jsonb('DTS dbt模型库'::text), true )::text, updated_at = ${now} WHERE template_code LIKE 'PRS-FLOWERBIZ-%' AND archived = false;
